question: Can a public POI alias pack plus high-precision scene-text proof add positive named-place authority and suppress appearance false confirmations on fresh buildings without turning absent text into NONE?

frozen_scope.development: Four entities and eight queries: one source-labeled identity-bearing view and one context view per entity.
frozen_scope.test: Four different entities and eight queries with the same source-only strata.
frozen_scope.prior_exclusion: All eight entities are absent from the 20 PB1 and 12 PB2-A entities.
frozen_scope.negative_boundary: Pairwise wrong-request rows are source-label negatives only; physical absence of every other entity is not claimed.
frozen_scope.portal_boundary: Portal proposals, portal crops, PB1 decisions, COMMIT, tracking, and active observation are not invoked.

arms.B0_APPEARANCE: Development selects CLIP, DINOv2, or fixed z-scored CLIP+DINO by Recall@1, positive acceptance, lower source-label-negative false confirmation, then Recall@3. Its balanced-accuracy threshold is also Development-only.
arms.C0_CANONICAL_TEXT: Only the canonical English entity name is eligible to produce a lexical proof; all non-proofs are UNKNOWN.
arms.C1_METADATA_ALIAS_PROOF: The frozen public alias list is eligible. OCR lines and adjacent line windows are normalized to lowercase ASCII alphanumerics. Alias similarity is SequenceMatcher ratio.
arms.C2_ASYMMETRIC_EVIDENCE_JOIN: If C1 proves exactly one entity, accept only a request for that entity and reject other requests. If C1 is UNKNOWN, preserve the B0 appearance decision. Text can authorize or veto on a proved frame; absent text never becomes NONE.

development_selection.text_thresholds: Enumerate observed alias-score midpoints plus 0 and 1.
development_selection.margin_thresholds: Enumerate observed top1-minus-top2 margin midpoints plus 0 and 1.
development_selection.objective: For C1, maximize proof precision, then correct proof coverage, then identity-bearing correct proof coverage, then higher score threshold and margin threshold. C0 uses the selected C1 thresholds unchanged so it cannot tune separately.
development_selection.no_test_adaptation: Test pixels, OCR, scores, labels, and outcomes are not opened until B0 arm/threshold and C1 score/margin thresholds are sealed.

metrics: lexical proof precision and query coverage
C2 acceptance gain and false-confirmation reduction versus B0

promotion_gate.proof_precision: C1 test proof precision must be at least 0.95 with no wrong-entity proof.
promotion_gate.identity_bearing_coverage: C1 must correctly prove at least 3/4 test identity-bearing queries.
promotion_gate.positive_guardrail: C2 test positive acceptance must be no lower than B0.
promotion_gate.false_confirmation_effect: C2 must reduce B0 source-label-negative false confirmations by at least 50% relative or 0.10 absolute.
promotion_gate.decision: All four clauses are required for L10_PB3_METADATA_BACKED_TEXT_IDENTITY_BRANCH_GATE_MET.

successor.gate_met: Retain GeoLex as an independent high-precision identity authority. Only C1-proved episodes may open a separately frozen portal-binding join; UNKNOWN episodes remain blocked or request SWEEP_SIGN/APPROACH_TEXT.
successor.gate_not_met: Close single-frame OCR alias proof on this source. Change to logo, external localization, or genuinely ordered multi-view evidence; do not tune aliases, thresholds, OCR models, or the opened cohort.

claim_boundary: Fresh building-disjoint public-image confirmation of a conditional metadata-plus-text identity branch. It is not text-visibility prevalence, exhaustive physical absence, universal OCR, portal ownership, navigation, arrival, product, user-benefit, or safety evidence.
